notes: G3 spec (target->all on the tap). Printed: '{1}{W}, {T}: Tap TARGET creature. Activate only if you control a creature with flying.' You control a flier, so the ability can be activated, but it taps one targeted creature only: activated without designating a target it cannot resolve (CR 601.2c, 602.2b), and the engine refuses it at resolution ('TARGET selector has no designation'). No creature gets tapped: neither the opponent's two creatures nor your flier. (activate() validates passed targets, V8; with none passed it leaves the check to resolution.)
